name: Ahrefs
description: Ahrefs lets agents research keywords, backlinks, organic traffic, and competitor sites with Ahrefs data. Each user signs in to their own Ahrefs account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find low-difficulty keywords about home espresso machines.
Which pages bring the most organic traffic to this competitor?
List the new backlinks to our site in the last 30 days.

apps.name: Ahrefs
apps.description: Keyword, backlink, and site research, over Ahrefs's MCP server with browser sign-in.
